name: Prop Mastery
body:
Prerequisite(s): Jester level 4th, proficiency with all jester props

Benefit(s): Choose one type of jester prop (orb, card, marotte, or pole). You gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls made with the chosen prop. Additionally, once per day, you can use that prop to cast a jester spell you know as if your caster level was 2 levels higher, without expending an additional spell slot.
